# BeagleY-AI hardware matrix

Maintainers have this board, so functions can be verified on hardware.

*Profile* is the profile that provides the function: `free`, `full` (needs non-free artifacts) or `blocked`. See [Free vs non-free](BeagleY-AI-Free-vs-NonFree).

| Function | Status | Profile | Features | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| boot | implemented-unverified | full | beagley-ai-boot-bundle |  |
| c7x-vision | implemented-unverified | full | beagley-ai-vision, beagley-ai-accelerator-runtime |  |
| camera | implemented-unverified | full | beagley-ai-csi0-imx219, beagley-ai-camera |  |
| displays | implemented-unverified | free | beagley-ai-dsi-rpi-7inch, beagley-ai-oldi-lcd185 |  |
| ethernet | implemented-unverified | free | beagley-ai-core |  |
| gpu | implemented-unverified | full | beagley-ai-gpu |  |
| header-routing | implemented-unverified | free | beagley-ai-header-uart1, beagley-ai-header-spi0, beagley-ai-header-mcasp0 |  |
| ipc-echo | implemented-unverified | full | beagley-ai-remoteproc-ipc |  |
| regnet-model | implemented-unverified | full | beagley-ai-regnet-model |  |
| sd-card | implemented-unverified | free | beagley-ai-image |  |
| serial-console | implemented-unverified | free | beagley-ai-core |  |
| usb-gadget | implemented-unverified | free | beagley-ai-usb-gadget |  |
| video-codec | implemented-unverified | full | beagley-ai-multimedia |  |
| wifi-ble | implemented-unverified | full | beagley-ai-wireless |  |
